calls.title: Inquirer Award Application Workshop
calls.summary: The team established a centralized experimentation program in 2022 using Growth Book, enhancing collaborative experimentation across various departments. Initially replacing fragmented tools, the program runs about 7 experiments monthly, accepting 70% of submitted requests. An open intake process encourages participation from all staff, fostering a culture of experimentation. Key outcomes include a 20% conversion lift from a paywall redesign and insights that have shaped product and marketing strategies. Although marketing and product teams currently plan experiments separately, there are opportunities for future collaboration. The program's ongoing goals include promoting a broader experimentation culture and gaining recognition through awards.
calls.keywords: Experimentation Culture Awards, Growth Book, A/B Testing, Experimentation at Scale, Paywall Conversion, Cross-Department Collaboration
